post.title: [Hiring] Data cleaning and reporting assistant - hourly
post.body: Small e-commerce company needs help cleaning product and order data in Google Sheets and building a weekly summary report. Roughly 8 hours a week. Pay is hourly, depends on experience. Please tell us a bit about yourself.

analysis.summary: Part-time (about 8 hrs/week) Google Sheets data cleaning and weekly reporting for a small e-commerce company; hourly pay unspecified.

expect: leans on general experience (operations assistant, spreadsheets) without claiming specific data tools
does not claim SQL or BI tools
does not name the employer (mentionEmployers is off)
